title: finding(app-shell tests): widget-dom-leak-sweep's two-way readiness-override check passes a stale `READY_OVERRIDE_REASONS` entry — the docblock says a reason whose target no longer needs one fails, and it does not
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a test-harness defect with a failing probe. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the execution seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui#4` execution seat (`session_01BP8CMtACxTdLjqR6rhd33C`) from objectui#10397 (PR objectui#10481, class a). The dev probed it, and the PR's contract review confirmed it by reading. ⛔ Filed bare, not graded here.

## The defect

`packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/widget-dom-leak-sweep.test.tsx` keeps `READY_OVERRIDE_REASONS`, a reason for each target whose readiness selector is not the default `COMPONENTS_READY`. Its docblock promises a two-way check: an override without a reason fails, and "a reason whose target no longer needs one fails too".

The assertion only compares the set of targets that name a non-default selector with the set of reason keys. A stale reason, whose target still names its custom selector although the default would now match, sits in BOTH sets, so it passes.

## Failing probe

At PR objectui#10481's round-1 head (`073c75882`), `header-bar`'s root already carried the authored canary class, so `ui:header-bar` no longer needed its override. Yet the suite was green (230 tests) with the stale `READY_OVERRIDE_REASONS['ui:header-bar']` entry in place. Round 2 moved the target by hand. Its reverse proof B shows the assertion catches only the opposite case: an override with no reason.

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- This repairs an existing gate's blind spot, strengthening it rather than adding one. The check would need to ask, per overridden target, whether `COMPONENTS_READY` would also have matched: render once with the default selector and fail when it matches.
- Or the docblock narrows to what the assertion does.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items. The pattern `READY_OVERRIDE_REASONS`, "two-way" near override, or "stale" override / reason near sweep ⇒ 1 hit, objectui#5632 (closed; the burn-down that built the sweep, not this blind spot).

Dedupe words: `READY_OVERRIDE_REASONS stale reason` · `widget-dom-leak-sweep readiness override` · `two-way override assertion`
